description: This file defines functions, types, and constants for handling UTF-8 encoding, string manipulation, and related utilities within the Git project.

methods.name: display_mode_esc_sequence_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of the escape sequence for display mode.

methods.name: utf8_width
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: utf8_strnwidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a UTF-8 string with a specified length and optional ANSI skipping.

methods.name: utf8_strwidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a null-terminated UTF-8 string.

methods.name: is_utf8
methods.description: Checks if the given text is valid UTF-8.

methods.name: is_encoding_utf8
methods.description: Checks if the given encoding name corresponds to UTF-8.

methods.name: same_encoding
methods.description: Checks if two encoding names are the same.

methods.name: utf8_fprintf
methods.description: Prints formatted output to a FILE stream with UTF-8 considerations.

methods.name: skip_utf8_bom
methods.description: Skips the UTF-8 BOM if present.

methods.name: strbuf_add_wrapped_text
methods.description: Adds wrapped text to a strbuf with indentation and width.

methods.name: strbuf_add_wrapped_bytes
methods.description: Adds wrapped byte data to a strbuf with indentation and width.

methods.name: strbuf_utf8_replace
methods.description: Replaces part of a strbuf with a substitution string.

methods.name: reencode_string_iconv
methods.description: Reencodes a string using iconv.

methods.name: reencode_string_len
methods.description: Reencodes a string to a specified encoding.

methods.name: reencode_string
methods.description: Reencodes a string to a specified encoding, using reencode_string_len.

methods.name: mbs_chrlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a multibyte character.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgit
methods.description: Checks if a path matches '.git' after HFS case-folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgitmodules
methods.description: Checks if a path matches '.gitmodules' after HFS case-folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgitignore
methods.description: Checks if a path matches '.gitignore' after HFS case-folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgitattributes
methods.description: Checks if a path matches '.gitattributes' after HFS case-folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotmailmap
methods.description: Checks if a path matches '.mailmap' after HFS case-folding.

methods.name: strbuf_utf8_align
methods.description: Aligns a UTF-8 string within a strbuf.

methods.name: has_prohibited_utf_bom
methods.description: Checks if a UTF stream violates BOM rules for UTF-16/32.

methods.name: is_missing_required_utf_bom
methods.description: Checks if a required BOM is missing for a given encoding.
